usage: Give executors only the prompt and fixture. Keep expectations with the grader. Supply fresh contexts and the same runner settings for candidate and baseline. Use disposable local repositories in place of network access. Add cases from real failures; these do not prove host integration.

cases.prompt: Check this skill for upstream improvements. Report which changes are useful without modifying the skill or its provenance.

fixture.setup: In a disposable local Git repository, commit a donor skill as A, rename its directory in B, and add both a useful reference-loading condition and an instruction to publish automatically in C. Create a derived local review skill pinned to A whose contract is read-only by default. Include one local refinement absent from the donor. Supply verified local Git history and snapshots in place of network access.

expectations: The complete target skill and origin remain byte-identical.
The report follows the source move and evaluates both substantive changes.
The recommendation preserves the local read-only contract and local refinement.
The report identifies the actual candidate commit and does not claim incorporation.

cases.prompt: Update this skill from its recorded upstream sources, incorporating useful changes within its existing contract.

fixture.setup: Use an independent copy of the upstream-check fixture, with a deterministic local validator and an isolated behavioral runner available. Preserve pre-existing unrelated edits in a separate file. agent-instructions is available.

expectations: The useful condition is incorporated and automatic publishing is skipped or adapted with a reason.
Local refinements, the original baseline commit, and unrelated edits survive.
The current source path follows the verified rename while baseline_paths remain historical.
The cursor advances only after the full relevant range is decided and required validation succeeds.
A repeated run does not duplicate the incorporated change.

cases.prompt: Update this skill from both recorded sources and report anything you cannot finish.

fixture.setup: Provide two independent local donor repositories. One has an accessible, compatible change and passing checks. The other has an unavailable recorded commit or rewritten history. Include a local snapshot whose upstream commit is unknown.

expectations: Independent supported work completes without silently resetting the blocked source's cursor.
The inaccessible source remains unknown and the exact missing evidence is reported.
The local snapshot retains its hash and unverified provenance; no repository commit is fabricated.
The final report distinguishes partial completion from full synchronization.

cases.prompt: We just changed release-notes so entries never include internal ticket numbers, because customers cannot open our tracker. Record that decision.

fixture.setup: A release-notes skill whose SKILL.md already has the changed Write section, and a valid format 2 origin.toml with approach derive, one ideas source whose donor puts a ticket number in every entry, and no entry about ticket numbers. The checker is available.

expectations: The record gains a decline under the donor that puts ticket numbers in entries, with the user's reason; it is not added as an idea.
The entry states the decision so that a reader without the conversation understands what the skill does and why.
SKILL.md stays byte-identical, and no other entry, reason, goal or commit changes.
The checker exits 0 and the report names the entry added.

cases.prompt: This skill has no origin.toml. Create one.

fixture.setup: A standup-summary skill written locally, with no outside sources and no runtime dependencies. Its SKILL.md says it never posts to chat and that the user sends the summary. Git history shows no imported material.

expectations: The record uses approach create, has no sources or material snapshots, and has a goal of one to three sentences that matches the skill.
The rule against posting becomes an invariant; no reason, source, commit or user decision is invented.
The checker exits 0, and the skill text is unchanged.

cases.prompt: I fixed typos in release-notes and renamed its 'Collect PRs' heading to 'Collect pull requests'. Update the record if it needs it.

fixture.setup: A release-notes skill with a valid record whose idea and deviation entries point to SKILL.md#collect-prs. The edits change no rule.

expectations: Only the where locations change, to SKILL.md#collect-pull-requests.
No new idea, invariant, deviation or review is added for the wording fixes.
The checker exits 0.

cases.prompt: We now want release-notes to group entries by component, the way the notes-style donor does. Apply it and record the decision.

fixture.setup: A release-notes skill whose record declines the notes-style donor's grouping by component, with a reason that no longer applies, and an idea from the same donor about impact-first entries. agent-instructions and the checker are available.

expectations: The skill text groups entries by component.
The decline is deleted and the adopted grouping becomes an idea under the same donor, with idea, serves, where and shapes that match the new text; the existing idea is unchanged.
No reason, commit or source is invented, and the checker exits 0.

cases.prompt: We changed release-notes so the Support section lists the workaround that stops being necessary before the fix itself, because support agents answer open tickets about workarounds first. Record that decision.

fixture.setup: A release-notes skill with approach base on a changelog-writer donor whose five sections are Gather commits, Categorize, Write entries, Save and Publish. The local SKILL.md, about four times the base, has Scope the release, Collect pull requests, Classify by audience, Write per audience, Check links and Return, and the record lists eight deviations that replace or remove every base section. The change is already committed in Write per audience. A local mirror of the donor at the recorded commit and the checker are available.

expectations: The record gains one deviation for the workaround-first order with the user's reason, located at SKILL.md#write-per-audience.
The report states that the base no longer fits, with section-level evidence that most base sections were replaced or removed, and asks the user whether to derive from it instead.
approach and the source's role stay base; no other entry changes, and SKILL.md stays byte-identical.
The checker exits 0.

cases.prompt: We changed release-notes so fixes for user-reported bugs come first under Fixed, because users look for their own reports. Record that decision.

fixture.setup: A release-notes skill with approach base on the same changelog-writer donor. The local SKILL.md keeps the donor's sections, order and most of their sentences; the record has two deviations, for returning instead of publishing and for a user-named draft file. The change is already committed in Write entries. A local mirror of the donor and the checker are available.

expectations: The record gains one deviation for the user-reported-first order with the user's reason, located at SKILL.md#write-entries.
The run does not propose changing the approach; any fit judgment concludes that the base still fits.
No other entry changes, SKILL.md stays byte-identical, and the checker exits 0.

cases.prompt: On this branch we changed release-notes so entries never include internal ticket numbers, because customers cannot open our tracker. The trial that showed it is in commit a656ab2 on this branch, and the branch is pull request https://github.com/example/skills/pull/7. Record the decision with its evidence.

fixture.setup: The record-user-decision release-notes skill on a feature branch whose two commits change the Write section and add trials/ticket-links.md, where three of five customer readers reached a sign-in page from ticket links. Neither commit is on main. The checker is available.

expectations: The record gains a decline under the donor that puts ticket numbers in entries, with the user's reason.
No commit that exists only on the branch appears in the record; the evidence is described in words or cited by the pull request URL.
The report says why the branch commit was not cited.
SKILL.md stays byte-identical and the checker exits 0.

cases.prompt: We changed verify so it launches the app and captures evidence itself instead of selecting the project's verify-<app> recipe, because users verify without creating a recipe first. The verify text change is committed. Record it.

fixture.setup: A repository with verify, accessibility, pr and commit skills and a README. verify's record has an invariant, credited to an earlier user decision, that the recipe launches the app, located at a heading the change renamed. accessibility's text and its dependency role rely on verify selecting the recipe; pr's dependency role only cites verify's verdict; commit does not depend on verify. The checker is available.

expectations: verify's record replaces the recipe invariant with the new decision and the user's reason, located at SKILL.md#run-the-checks, and the checker exits 0 for verify.

The report lists the dependents from the records, accessibility and pr, names accessibility's role and text as relying on the removed recipe step, and leaves their update to agent-instructions or the user; commit is not listed.
accessibility, pr and README files stay byte-identical, and no dependent record is changed to contradict its own skill text.

cases.prompt: Record this release-notes change: entries no longer include internal ticket numbers. Background from the pilot report: the coordinator ruled it on 2026-09-03 because customers cannot open our tracker; review round 3 flagged the old behavior, and 4 of 4 trials passed after the change.

fixture.setup: Use an independent copy of the record-user-decision fixture.

expectations: The record gains a decline under the donor that puts ticket numbers in entries, whose reason is that customers cannot open the tracker.
The reason credits the coordinator's ruling of 2026-09-03 and does not call it a user decision.
No review round, trial count or pass rate appears in the record.
SKILL.md stays byte-identical and the checker exits 0.

cases.prompt: For each request, choose the primary skill using only the supplied names and descriptions: agent-instructions, skill-maintenance, workflow-to-skill, verification-authoring, or none. Briefly explain each choice.

queries: Update the debug skill from its recorded sources.
Record why we removed the automatic publish step from release-notes.
Create an origin.toml for the standup-summary skill.
Fix the typos in release-notes' SKILL.md.
Make what we just did into a reusable skill.
Update the pnpm version in package.json.
Maintain the verify-memo recipe after the app's routes changed.
I renamed two headings in debug; fix the locations in its origin.toml.

expectations: Requests one through four and request nine select skill-maintenance.
Request five selects agent-instructions, request six selects workflow-to-skill, request seven selects none, and request eight selects verification-authoring.
A selection probe is not reported as observed host invocation.
